item.title: Official ‘KPop Demon Hunters’ Light Sticks Release Ahead of Global Tour — Here’s Where to Shop
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Hey there, K-pop fans! Are you ready to get your hands on the ultimate concert accessory? The official KPop Demon Hunters light sticks are now available online, just in time for the highly-anticipated global concert tour.
[Music transitions to a K-pop-inspired beat]
Host: "You might've seen light sticks at K-pop concerts, where they turn arenas into coordinated displays of color. And, surprisingly, they even made an appearance at the Academy Awards this year, with celebrities like Emma Stone and Leonardo DiCaprio waving them during HUNTR/X's performance.
[Short sound clip of a K-pop concert crowd cheering]
Host: "Now, you can get your own official KPop Demon Hunters light stick, complete with synchronization mode, five color modes, and over eight lighting patterns. It's easy to use, comes with batteries, and is officially licensed from Netflix and Hasbro.
[Music transitions to a short sound clip of a light stick sound effect]
Host: "There are two light sticks to choose from: the HUNTR/X and the Saja Boys light stick, both available online at Amazon and Walmart. And, as a reminder, don't wait until the concert day to get yours - order it now and be prepared to join in on the fun!
[Music transitions back to the main beat]
Host: "The KPop Demon Hunters light sticks are just the beginning. You can also get wigs inspired by the HUNTR/X girls, perfect for a concert or a sing-along night at home.
[Outro music plays]
Host: "Thanks for tuning in! Get your KPop Demon Hunters light sticks and wigs now, and get ready to join the K-pop revolution!"
